title: Carl Miller - Right to travel without a license pl
summary: Promoter recounts beating a no-plates ticket in Michigan traffic court by citing right-to-travel cases.

assertions.quote: I have a right to travel freely un encumbered pursuant to Shapiro versus Thompson
Shuttlesworth versus Birmingham Alabama says I can ignore the license and engage in a right with impunity
he says motion granted and he ran off the bench

verdicts.note: Promoters' dismissal stories are anecdotes; courts routinely convict on these charges and reject the argument.
The right-to-travel defendant was convicted of failure to display a license plate, and the appeal court affirmed; one case.
